structural_change: NEW kit (KV-AHUB3 10-19, LEAD2-KV queue: AHUB steps a-d after KV-AHUB2 7222d4264). sfa/sfb (single clock, symmetric insertion-aware spine) failed the clock rule terminally (spread 86.5/97.3, 116.3/123.2 TT/FF): one tree across 734 x 540 um padded every hub flop to the children insertion. Structural redesign: qkd_ahub_static_dw_g2 (wires-only flat form of qkd_ahub_static_dw_safe, same children / nets) -> lp.py LANDED parent qkd_ahub_static_dw_g2_lp: regions c + z0..z3, 8 landings (4 x 268-b commands c->z, 4 x 68-b roots z->c, chunk 8 b, per-chunk reset forest), 1-bit reset runs only across regions; lockstep == flat parent with ZW_RLY = ZR_RLY = 3. The private grouped ZH transport (KV-AHUB2) is NOT used: the lp.py landing is the two-clock form it lacked (step a). Synthesis from RTL with OT_KEEP_REGS + keep_pin_regs + pin_reg_split (the am face copies at source level instead of the fixed-hash native netlist, step d).
